description: Unicode NFC normalisation: NFD-encoded and NFC-encoded inputs with identical logical content produce identical pack_hash (R3).
notes: The string 'caf\u00e9' (NFC U+00E9) and 'cafe\u0301' (NFD: e + combining acute) are logically identical. After NFC normalisation both must produce this exact pack_hash. Any implementation that does not apply NFC before hashing will fail this vector.
